items.title: Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: Well there’s still the Tommy Dorsey band and there’s maybe a Woody Herman band.

ctx.x: Who can you go on the road with now? Count Basie is the only band left. And that’s not Basie of course it’s a ghost band.
Well there’s still the Tommy Dorsey band and there’s maybe a Woody Herman band.
I think that’s part time. I don’t think the guy does it all the time or something. But there’s not much of a choice. But of course now you can go to almost any college and study jazz,
